relations.name: Commission engineering information delivery
relations.description: Owner-defined obligations and acceptance requirements govern EPC delivery.

relations.name: Set review and issue priorities
relations.description: Engineering leadership assigns technical owners; document control preserves process and evidence.

relations.name: Clarify supplier information obligations
relations.description: Document control communicates expected items, validation results and formal responses.

relations.name: Submit controlled supplier packages
relations.description: Supplier provides traceable documentation and resolves recorded rejection reasons.

relations.name: Agree operating information readiness
relations.description: The receiving operations team specifies what makes handover usable.

relations.name: Return operating discrepancies
relations.description: Maintenance identifies mismatches requiring engineering assessment and authorized modification.

relations.name: Report assurance findings
relations.description: Assurance supplies acceptance and custody findings; the owner retains investment and acceptance accountability.

relations.name: Provide access and service evidence
relations.description: Technical service ownership supplies scope-specific recovery, permission and export evidence.

relations.name: Set rollout and integration acceptance
relations.description: IT assigns source ownership and accepts service boundaries before cutover.

relations.name: Transfer configuration and administration
relations.description: Implementation trains document-control administrators using real exception cases.

relations.name: Enable asset-context use
relations.description: Implementation validates tags and retrieval tasks with operating engineers.

relations.name: Approve a governed service investment
relations.description: Economic sponsorship funds the agreed information service and accountable technical ownership.
